algorithm.title: Suggested Evaluation of Patient With Hypercalcemia.

cell.label: History and exam focused on vitamin, milk-alkali ingestion, history of malignancy, medications, or history of immobilization
Hyperparathyroidism (1% will have familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia and low 24-h calcium excretion)
Evaluate for cancer (esp. lung CA, myeloma, lymphoma, or bone metastasis)
Other possible causes and suggested tests: • Hyperthyroidism: TSH • Adrenal insufficiency – cortisol • Granulomatous disease – CXR • Vitamin A or D toxicity – levels
